decisions: Keep public portable-fringe execution disabled; do not add this candidate to accepted gallery or replace approved assets.
Treat float normals, exact skin preservation and staged memory success as technical components, not overall avatar approval.
native_reload_caveat: Rest render controls and rig transforms are preserved, but four of five prior rest-image comparisons differ. One back view has identical pixels; no new pixel-error tolerance or universal appearance-parity claim.

Flying companion and alternate panda pose are visible in real sampled native/GLB renders; this is not a full video or physical flight validation.
Exposed cheek/shoulder defects remain when the dragon leaves. Exported preview reveals broad shoulder artifacts and scattered light/green fragments.
Exported fringe shows conspicuous short upright spikes/strips on some contours, with smoother-looking dark body areas; it does not match dense Muse fur.
